# ubik documentation

> Learn how to use the ubik workspace to review source context, ask across connected apps, capture meeting decisions, and carry obligations to completion.

## Start

- [Getting started](https://docs.theubik.com/index.md): A short introduction to the ubik workspace and the Read or Watch learning paths.
- [Read Inbox](https://docs.theubik.com/getting-started/read.md): Read the source thread before its summary.
- [Read Ask ubik](https://docs.theubik.com/getting-started/read/ask-ubik.md): Attach sources that can change the answer.
- [Read Meetings](https://docs.theubik.com/getting-started/read/meetings.md): Review decisions and owners before notes enter workspace memory.
- [Read Tasks](https://docs.theubik.com/getting-started/read/tasks.md): Track who owes the next move and the evidence attached.
- [Watch Inbox](https://docs.theubik.com/getting-started/watch.md): See the thread-first Inbox loop.
- [Watch Ask ubik](https://docs.theubik.com/getting-started/watch/ask-ubik.md): See a suggestion become a connected prompt.
- [Watch Meetings](https://docs.theubik.com/getting-started/watch/meetings.md): See a conversation become reviewed notes.
- [Watch Tasks](https://docs.theubik.com/getting-started/watch/tasks.md): See obligations grouped by owner and evidence.
- [Sign in](https://docs.theubik.com/getting-started/sign-in.md): Enter an ubik workspace and choose the right account.
- [Workspace basics](https://docs.theubik.com/getting-started/workspace-basics.md): Understand the workspace navigation and review surfaces.
- [How ubik AI works](https://docs.theubik.com/getting-started/how-ubik-ai-works.md): Use source-backed recommendations while preserving operator control.
- [ubik vs. other LLMs](https://docs.theubik.com/getting-started/vs-other-llms.md): Understand how workspace context differs from a general chatbot.

## Core workflows

- [Ask ubik](https://docs.theubik.com/workflows/ask-ubik.md): Build source-aware operator prompts with connected apps, files, and organization knowledge.
- [Inbox](https://docs.theubik.com/workflows/inbox.md): Read the thread first, inspect context on demand, and move the work.
- [Meetings](https://docs.theubik.com/workflows/meetings.md): Capture locally, review notes, and keep decisions and follow-ups searchable.
- [Tasks](https://docs.theubik.com/workflows/tasks.md): Track obligations by who owes the next move, evidence, activity, and closure receipts.

## Administration

- [Connected tools](https://docs.theubik.com/admin/integrations.md): Choose which systems ubik may read from or update.
- [Users and access](https://docs.theubik.com/admin/users-and-access.md): Manage workspace membership and roles.
- [Security and data](https://docs.theubik.com/admin/security-and-data.md): Review data boundaries, model use, and writeback controls.

## Support

- [FAQ](https://docs.theubik.com/troubleshooting/faq.md): Troubleshoot common workspace, integration, and workflow questions.
